protocol: Existing repository whole-document GenerationBenchmarks, frozen before candidate implementation or timing
primaryBoundary: Repeated core document generation from the unchanged supported repository benchmark and its real ApiDescription producer. Not business request throughput, HTTP serialization, or a claim about production document-request frequency.
functionalRequirements: Existing coordinator producer-to-document 15-row request-body selection, including both values of every Boolean theory, passes for baseline and candidate using the same fixed filter.
Real loaded helper preserves null out and false for zero or multiple Body descriptions, exact object and true for exactly one Body description, and separation of Body from Form/FormFile.
Direct helper multi-body characterization is not evidence that multiple physically bound JSON bodies are supported by RequestDelegateFactory.
Untimed inspection of unchanged benchmark setup and actual generated document checks the three operation counts before any measurement.
Source diff is one fused indexed body-selection loop only; no public contract, form-selector, fixture, dataset, runtime or dependency changes.

benchmarkDotNet.toolchain: Pinned BenchmarkDotNet in-process no-emit engine with a small private IExecutor/IToolchain adapter that omits stock process/thread priority and affinity assignments. The existing pinned internal runner is bound explicitly before measurement; no library patch, new IVT or shipping reflection change.

schedule.baselineForBlock: Geometric mean of BaselineBefore and BaselineAfter, separately for elapsed and allocated bytes.
schedule.baselineControl: BaselineBefore versus identical BaselineAfter image, never a different workload.

acceptance.aggregation: Geometric mean of seven candidate/block-baseline ratios, separately per parameter and metric.
acceptance.allocationMetric: BenchmarkDotNet MemoryDiagnoser bytes per unchanged GenerateDocument invocation, not isolated helper allocation.
acceptance.failedControlOrIncompleteExecution: Inconclusive, not measured no gain or a successful optimization.

execution.runtimePolicy: Original exact 12.0.0-alpha.1.26562.105. Default exact runtime selected from its pinned source graph and frozen with accepted images before its comparison; no runtime substitution or source-role pooling.
execution.commonImage: Unchanged built repository benchmark, tests, dependency graph, and private adapter; causal variants may differ only in Microsoft.AspNetCore.OpenApi.dll and its PDB.
execution.requiresBeforeTiming: Plan seal, green functional acceptance, all-file causal inventories, observed loaded runtime/owner/fixture identities, approved child-awaiting driver and launcher hashes, owned coordinator native work quiescent, actual global gateway lease. Merely writing this plan does not authorize measurement.
execution.sharedHostLimitations: No dedicated isolation or universal unrelated-process inactivity is claimed. Untimed helper work on separate hosts may continue.
